artifact_root: Directory containing provenance.json (preserve the uploaded relative directory tree).

exit_status.0: No remaining structural/statistical validation error. Metric evidence can still be partial; inspect metric_validity, evidence_status and all warnings.
exit_status.1: Missing/mismatching/incomplete evidence or invalid measurements; JSON includes errors.

preparation_validation: Synthetic primitive tests for nearest-rank quantiles, retained extreme observation, overlapping timeline union and phase-boundary exclusion passed.
Empty-artifact smoke test returns incomplete evidence rather than a successful measurement.
Source-graph primitive checks cover valid upstream/direct-child designs and reject reversed ancestry, merge/missing/wrong parents, extra paths, mode changes and identical blobs.
Observed-schema corrections narrowly recognize the two declared nonreader skips and preserve missing pipeline evidence; required reader counts and data checks are unchanged.
command_template_note: Run from the evidence bundle directory; REPOSITORY_ROOT is a Git checkout containing the pinned candidate commit. The checkout itself need not be on that commit.

whole-pr.source_graph: Pinned baseline must be an ancestor of candidate; no reverse-topology exception.

representation-only.source_graph: Flat control baseline must have exactly one parent, equal to candidate; candidate must be its merge-base.

run_separation: Supply the exact hardwareId for this run and attempt; each output file is new and must be kept separate. Existing output files are rejected. Do not pool observations or ratios across runs.
recorded_source_evidence: Source graph, both tree IDs and changed-file blob IDs; representation-only also records the exact production diff in baseline-to-candidate direction and its SHA-256.
cleanliness_evidence_note: Missing final status/diff text is explicitly reported as an evidence limitation; clean manifests and successful harness guards corroborate source cleanliness. Existing nonempty status/diff remains an error. Do not fabricate missing files.
pipeline_availability_note: Missing timeline markers with matching raw unavailableReason remain unavailable and are reported separately; no pipeline reconstruction or zero substitution. Duplicate markers or raw/derived disagreement remain errors.
